purpose: Regression fixtures for RASG-023. They prove that plan-complete, design-complete, route-only, or partial-with-explicit-defer conclusions cannot close unless every deferred item has durable tracking, owner surface, acceptance boundary, and revisit trigger.

cases.completed_claim: RASG-017 completed the target root information architecture model, inventory, and consumer matrix.

deferred_items.description: Physical root information architecture consolidation apply remains open.
deferred_items.acceptance_boundary: RASG-022 can close only with apply or explicit deferral receipt covering dry-run, aliases, rollback, consumer matrix, package safety, clean E2E, Prism review, and closeout receipt.
deferred_items.revisit_trigger: Before formal npm/public release readiness, or before any large physical root directory migration.
deferred_items.blocking_relationship: Blocks public release readiness if neither applied nor explicitly deferred.

deferred_items.description: Physical apply remains open but has no durable tracking.

cases.completed_claim: A non-executable naming note was reviewed and intentionally has no follow-up apply work.

no_follow_up_justification.reason: The design was documentation-only and did not create an apply, release, migration, or governance follow-up.
no_follow_up_justification.acceptance_boundary: Close only if the report states there is no physical apply or deferred scope.
no_follow_up_justification.revisit_trigger: Revisit if the same conclusion is later used to justify a file move, release posture, or completion claim.
